name: What are the benefits of replacing old windows?
description: Benefits include improved energy efficiency, lower utility bills, increased comfort, better curb appeal, and enhanced security.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of replacing old windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing old windows can significantly improve your home's energy efficiency, reduce utility bills, and enhance comfort by minimizing drafts. New windows also boost curb appeal, increase property value, and can offer better noise reduction and security. When considering options, understand that the material, glazing, and installation quality will directly impact these benefits, so prioritize finding a balance that suits your budget and long-term goals.
